commitments.statement: Kestrel Data does not offer on-premises or self-hosted deployment. Kestrel Insight is multi-tenant SaaS only, with no single-tenant, private-cloud, air-gapped, or customer-VPC option, and none on the roadmap.
Kestrel Data encrypts all customer data at rest with AES-256-GCM.
Kestrel Data commits to a Recovery Time Objective of 4 hours.
Kestrel Data enforces hardware-backed multi-factor authentication for 100% of personnel with production access.
Kestrel Data has never experienced a customer data breach.
